item.title: Worth the cold: Polar Plunge benefits Special Olympics Pennsylvania
item.description: Dozens of participants in costumes and matching shirts plunged into icy water Saturday at the Northeast Pennsylvania Polar Plunge at Montage Mountain to benefit Special Olympics Pennsylvania.

item.title: Hanover Area’s Caines wins regional title; 14 WVC wrestlers reach states
item.description: The Wyoming Valley Conference will send 14 wrestlers across three classifications to next weekend’s PIAA Wrestling Championships as the Northeast and Central Regionals wrapped up on Saturday.

item.title: District 2 Boys Basketball: 2nd-half surge downs Dallas in 4A championship
item.description: WILKES-BARRE TWP. — Perhaps the worst 10 minutes for Dallas on Saturday was when a little boy was on the court trying to make shots to win a prize.

item.title: District 2 Boys Basketball: WBA boys edged by DelVal in OT of 6A finals
item.description: WILKES-BARRE TWP. — Trey Newton carried Delaware Valley down the stretch Saturday night, helping the third-seeded Warriors emerge from their first trip to the Mohegan Arena with the District 2-4 Class 6A Subregional boys basketball championship by outlasting Wilkes-Barre Area 51-48 in overtime.

item.title: District 2 Girls Basketball: Holy Redeemer falls to Dunmore on last-second shot
item.description: WILKES-BARRE TWP. — Holy Redeemer gave up three scoring runs to Dunmore on Saturday afternoon.

item.title: Community honors ‘Lala’ Clark with candlelight vigil
item.description: WILKES-BARRE — More than 100 people gathered Saturday evening for a candlelight vigil at 55 Thayer St. to celebrate the life of La’Niyah “Lala” Clark.

item.title: D2 Girls Basketball: Dougherty reaches 1,000 points as Crestwood rolls to title
item.description: WILKES-BARRE TWP. — Crestwood took the suspense out of the District 2 Class 5A girls basketball title game quickly Saturday night. Senior Guard Keira Dougherty played a big reason.

item.title: Around Town: London trip filled with charm, history, culture
item.description: Between the historic sights, the welcoming people and fun pubs and restaurants, our London trip exceeded all expectations.

item.title: Tell Giselle: Teachable moments sans shame
item.description: “My boyfriend joined a men’s group that had been started by a mutual friend that I like. Some of the others in the group I have met. A few I only know through social media. There are some guys who are on the seamy side. I want my boyfriend to drop out but am not sure how much friction this will cause.”

item.title: What’s Up, NEPA? — Week of Monday, Feb. 23, 2026
item.description: Purim in Candy Land, a community Purim celebration, 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. March 1 at the Friedman JCC, 613 SJ Strauss Lane, Kingston, with a Midrasha presentation, Shelach Manot making, Hamantaschen making, singing with Cantor, costume contest, pizza and candy, a bounce house, bingo, Karaoke and fun for all ages. Costumes are encouraged. For more info, call 570-824-4646.
